newsitem.title: USA: Viragen moves up to Nasdaq.
newsitem.headline: Viragen moves up to Nasdaq.

text.p: Viragen Inc said Tuesday its common stock would begin trading on the Nasdaq National Market on December 27 after a stint on the Nasdaq SmallCap Market.
It said the stock would retain its symbol, "VRGN".

Viragen Inc is a biopharmaceutical company that researches, develops, manufactures and studies natural human interferons for the treatment of various viral diseases and immune disorders, including HIV/AIDS, hepatitis B & C and multiple sclerosis.
